assignmentHtml.task: Research ChuChu TV Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs YouTube channel comprehensively. Find: (1) Stable channel ID and canonical URL. (2) Operator: ChuChu TV / Southern Lights Media / Southlight Studios. Corporate chain. (3) Channel creation date and earliest still-public upload. (4) Operating location and displayed country. (5) Languages. (6) Primary content category (children's nursery rhymes). (7) Content supply model: commissioned children's animation. (8) Representative works. Provide direct source URLs.
assignmentHtml.context: ChuChu TV is #38 with ~60B lifetime views per Communitrics snapshot dated September 2, 2026. Need verifiable facts with source links.
assignmentHtml.expected_output: A structured dossier for ChuChu TV with all requested fields, each with source URLs.

answerHtml: Structured dossier for ChuChu TV Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs, compiled from official YouTube metadata, Wikipedia, LinkedIn, press releases, and industry sources. NOTE: The hypothesized connection between ChuChu TV and 'Southern Lights Media' / 'Southlight Studios' could not be verified — no source links these names to ChuChu TV; the documented operator is ChuChu TV Studios.

evidence.snippet: Channel: '@ChuChuTV • 98.2M subscribers•1,132 videos'; 'India Joined Feb 8, 2013 ... 60,532,927,024 views'. Description identifies English-language edutainment content featuring Bestie, Baby Taku, ABCs, nursery rhymes.
evidence.supports: Stable channel ID UCBnZ16ahKA2DZ_T5W0FPUXg; canonical URL https://www.youtube.com/@ChuChuTV; displayed country India; creation date Feb 8, 2013; total views ~60.5B.

evidence.snippet: 'Chubby Cheeks Rhyme with Lyrics and Actions - ChuChu TV Nursery Rhymes Cartoon Animation Song Video' uploaded Feb 14, 2013; 102,756,263 views; channel: 'ChuChu TV Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs'.
evidence.supports: Earliest still-public upload: Chubby Cheeks, Feb 14, 2013.

evidence.snippet: 'Company Name: ChuChu TV'; 'Industry: Animation and Post-production'; 'Headquarters: Chennai, Tamil Nadu'; 'Founded 2013'; 'Type: Privately Held'; 'Company size: 51-200 employees'.
evidence.supports: Operator: ChuChu TV Studios; headquartered Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.

evidence.snippet: 'The ChuChu TV YouTube Channel is the property of ChuChuTV Studios, a media firm based in Chennai, India.' Contact: Vinoth Chandar, Founder, CEO & Creative Director.
evidence.supports: Corporate entity is ChuChuTV Studios (also styled ChuChu TV Studios), Chennai-based. No mention of Southern Lights Media or Southlight Studios.

evidence.snippet: 'The ChuChu TV YouTube Channel is the property of ChuChu TV Studios, a media & technology firm based in Chennai, India.' Network spans '12 YouTube channels spanning languages of English, Hindi, Tamil, Telegu, Bengali, Spanish, Portuguese and French.' The Phonics song has crossed 4 billion views; 6 videos cross 1 billion views.
evidence.supports: Languages (12-channel network across 8+ languages); content category (children's edutainment/nursery rhymes); content supply model (in-house studio production by ~200 animators). Global licensing via Dream Theatre.

evidence.snippet: 'ChuChu TV is an Indian network of YouTube channels that creates edutainment content for children from ages 1 to 6.' 'Years active: 2013–present'; 'Genre: Edutainment'; 'Subscribers: 98.1 million'; 'Views: 58.2 billion'. Network spans '12 YouTube channels in different languages (English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Spanish, Portuguese, French, etc.).'
evidence.supports: Content category: children's edutainment/nursery rhymes; multi-language network; primary channel details.

evidence.snippet: 'Phonics Song 2 with TWO Words in 3D - A For Airplane' by ChuChu TV Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs; 2,607,629,506 views; uploaded Apr 10, 2019.
evidence.supports: Representative work: Phonics Song 2 (A for Airplane) – 2.6B views.

evidence.snippet: 'Boo Boo Song plus more Baby Songs - ChuChu TV Baby Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs - Baby Taku's World'; 1,097,680,515 views; uploaded Nov 11, 2019.
evidence.supports: Representative work: Boo Boo Song compilation – 1.1B views.

evidence.snippet: 'ABC Song with ChuChu Toy Train - Alphabet Song for Kids - ChuChu TV'; 552,935,265 views; uploaded Dec 24, 2019.
evidence.supports: Representative work: ABC Song with ChuChu Toy Train – 552M views.

evidence.snippet: 'ChuChu TV Classics - Phonics Song with Two Words | Nursery Rhymes and Kids Songs'; 1,584,049,069 views; uploaded Jul 24, 2020.
evidence.supports: Representative work: Phonics Song with Two Words (Classics version) – 1.58B views.

evidence.snippet: 'ChuChu TV began in 2013 when an Indian tech engineer, Vinoth Chandar, made a cartoon for his young daughter.' Network includes specialized channels: ChuChu TV Surprise, ChuChu TV Storytime, ChuChu TV FunZone. 'In 2016, ChuChu TV announced a licensing and merchandising partnership with DreamTheatre.'
evidence.supports: Founding story, channel network structure, corporate partnerships. Confirms ChuChu TV Studios as the operator. No mention of Southern Lights Media or Southlight Studios anywhere.
